scope: Codex second visual pass of nine structured draft objects against the full rendered slides of the public development PPTX. This is not an independent human review, a production judgment, or an independent evaluation source.

results.finding: The GEO, MEO and LEO columns each had an omitted final characteristic row. The draft now keeps those rows separate from latency and operation.
All seven headers, three orbit rows, approximate values and unexplained asterisks match the visible table.
The four scope-to-list associations match the visible quadrants; the arrows do not establish a legal hierarchy.
The five criteria and four columns match the qualitative circle fills; no numeric score is printed.
Four strategic-choice branches match the original labels and order; no ranking is shown.
Green/red comparisons match all three rows and both spectrum columns; the slide frames them as advantages and disadvantages.
The thirteen displayed 2024-to-2035 value pairs match. The chart does not print units beside those pairs.
The two policy cards' asterisks and the CA/272 response qualifier were missing from the draft and are now preserved.
The Environment Reports and Space Debris card titles were flattened with their details. The draft now records the visible card hierarchy.
